solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Piggy in extremely messy sty

parts.note: extremely means too, as in 'too kind'

indicators.note: a messy sty has its letters jumbled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A pig is found in a filthy pigsty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Piggy' looks like an adjective or a pet name for a pig, but it is the childish word for a toe ('this little piggy'). The anagram of STY is TSY.
explanation.definitionFit: A tootsy is a nursery word for a toe, and 'piggy' is another, from the toe-counting rhyme.

clue.text: Workers accepting orders are leaderless, no doubt

indicators.note: accepting means taking the orders inside

parts.note: TU is a trade union, a body of workers
OBEs are orders of the British Empire, honours

indicators.note: leaderless means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: taken as written before losing its head

explanation.surface: Workers taking instructions are, without question, left with no boss.
explanation.walkthrough: TU takes in OBES; then ARE loses its leader A to give RE.
explanation.definitionFit: 'To be sure' is an idiom meaning certainly, admittedly, without question.

clue.text: Enigmatic vampire heading off to puncture men

indicators.note: to puncture means to go inside, as fangs go into skin

parts.note: OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

indicators.note: heading off means the vampire's name loses its first letter

parts.note: Dracula is the famous vampire

explanation.surface: A mysterious vampire sets off to bite some men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Men' is the military sense: OR, other ranks, the soldiers who are not officers.
explanation.definitionFit: Oracular means like an oracle's pronouncements: cryptic, ambiguous and mysterious.

clue.text: Governor posed on carpet

parts.note: to pose for a portrait is to sit, so posed gives sat
to carpet is to reprimand, the same as to rap

explanation.surface: A governor sits for a portrait on a rug.
explanation.walkthrough: Carpet looks like a rug, but is the verb for a dressing-down.
explanation.definitionFit: A satrap was a provincial governor in ancient Persia.

clue.text: Passionate at first, though affair is miserable

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter of the word before is used here

parts.note: first letter of Passionate
if can mean though, as in 'pleasant, if dull'
a fling is a brief love affair

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a love affair that began passionately but turned wretched.
explanation.definitionFit: Miserable can mean paltry or trifling, as in 'a miserable sum', which is the sense of something trivially small.

clue.text: Wings of idiotic aviator, useless flyer

indicators.note: wings are the two sides, so each word gives its outer letters

parts.note: outer letters of idiotic
outer letters of aviator
outer letters of useless

explanation.surface: A foolish airman with useless wings, a hopeless flyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wings of' applies to all three words, each giving its first and last letters.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this figure flew on wax and feather wings and fell when he went too near the sun.

clue.text: Blaze is full of unknown combustion particles

indicators.note: is full of means the unknown sits inside

parts.note: a flash is a sudden blaze of light
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A fire contains some mystery combustion particles.
explanation.definitionFit: Fly ash is the fine residue carried up in flue gases from burning coal.

clue.text: India ignoring case of British disease

parts.note: I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: ignoring case means dropping the outside letters of the word

parts.note: inner letters of British

explanation.surface: India ignores a British disease case.
explanation.definitionFit: Iritis is an inflammation of the iris of the eye, a medical condition.

clue.text: Characters in igloo got married and were radiant

indicators.note: characters in means the letters inside the word, leaving off its two ends

parts.note: inner letters of igloo
wed means got married

explanation.surface: A couple in an igloo got married and looked radiant.
explanation.definitionFit: Glowed means shone or looked flushed with happiness, being radiant.

clue.text: Runs away from Bristol's brutes

indicators.note: away from means the runs are taken out of the word that follows

parts.note: Bristols is rhyming slang (Bristol City, titties) for breasts
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Something runs away from the city of Bristol's brutish inhabitants.
explanation.walkthrough: Bristol looks like the English city, but 'Bristols' is British rhyming slang for breasts; take R out of BREASTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Beasts are animals, or by extension cruel savage people, which is what brutes are.

clue.text: Cabin boy mixed milky drink

indicators.note: mixed means the letters of cabin boy are stirred into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A ship's cabin boy prepares a milky drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A babycino is frothed milk served in a small cup for children at coffee shops.

clue.text: Tell tales of picaresque Albanians

indicators.note: of here means the letters are taken out from within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across picareSQUE ALbanians

explanation.surface: Someone tells stories about roguish adventuring Albanians.
explanation.definitionFit: To squeal is slang for informing on someone, which is telling tales.

clue.text: I sell spun yarn

indicators.note: spun means the letters are twisted round into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A seller offers yarn that has been spun.
explanation.walkthrough: Yarn could be a story, but here it is thread.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisle is a fine, smooth cotton thread used for stockings.

clue.text: Trump forbidden female nurses at home

parts.note: out can mean not allowed, as in 'that's out'

indicators.note: nurses means holds within, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: she is the female pronoun
in means at home

explanation.surface: A political story: Trump banned while a woman tends him at home.
explanation.walkthrough: Trump looks like the politician but is a verb meaning surpass.
explanation.definitionFit: To trump someone is to beat or surpass them, as to outshine them is to be better.

clue.text: Works ever so excitedly, embracing university

indicators.note: embracing means the jumbled letters hold the university letter inside
excitedly means the letters are agitated into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Something works ever so energetically at a university.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of EVERSO gives OEVRES, which takes U inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An oeuvre is the body of work of an artist; the plural means bodies of work.

clue.text: Sanctimonious boy behind complaint

indicators.note: behind means the boy's name comes after the other piece

parts.note: pi is a short form of pious, meaning sanctimonious
Les is a boy's name, short for Leslie

explanation.surface: A self-righteous boy is behind some complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Complaint' here is an ailment: piles are haemorrhoids.
explanation.definitionFit: Piles are haemorrhoids, an ailment, and complaint can mean a medical condition.

clue.text: Stern parent

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the back of a ship
second meaning: to bring up children, as a verb

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as a strict mother or father; stern is the ship's back end and parent is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names the back end of something such as a boat, and the verb means to raise offspring.

clue.text: Set designer exposed on radio

indicators.note: on radio means the word is heard rather than seen

parts.note: bared means exposed

explanation.surface: A stage-set designer is exposed on a radio broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set designer' looks theatrical, but the set is a television set.
explanation.definitionFit: John Logie Baird was the Scottish engineer who pioneered television, designing early TV sets.

clue.text: Reportedly floated bottle in river

indicators.note: reportedly means the answer is how the words sound when spoken

parts.note: floated through the air means flew; a vial is a small bottle

explanation.surface: A message in a bottle floated down a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Fluvial is the adjective for things found in or produced by rivers.

clue.text: Cheerful son regularly earns almost 21 shillings

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

indicators.note: regularly means taking every second letter of earns

parts.note: even letters of earns

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is lost

parts.note: a guinea was a coin worth 21 shillings in old British money

explanation.surface: A son earns almost a guinea and is happy.
explanation.walkthrough: A guinea was an old British unit of 21 shillings, one pound and one shilling.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanguine means optimistic and confident, a hopeful, cheerful outlook.

clue.text: None is as recklessly ready to mate

indicators.note: recklessly means the letters are thrown about wildly

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Nobody is as rashly eager to pair up.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal in season is in heat, the period of the breeding cycle when it accepts a partner.

clue.text: Man and offspring rejecting society

indicators.note: rejecting means the society letter is thrown out of the word

parts.note: spawn means offspring

explanation.surface: A father and child turn away from polite society.
explanation.walkthrough: Man is a chess piece here, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess every piece is a man, and the pawn is the humblest one.

clue.text: One-time Tea Party member mostly leaning to the right

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: mostly means the name loses its last letter

parts.note: Alice joins the Mad Hatter's Tea Party in Alice in Wonderland

explanation.surface: A former member of the US Tea Party movement with right-wing leanings.
explanation.walkthrough: One-time and Tea Party suggest the US political movement; split into one, time and the Mad Hatter's tea party guest.
explanation.definitionFit: Italic type slopes forward, its letters leaning towards the right.

clue.text: Family supporting person in sewer

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue means the family sits below the person

parts.note: a bod is slang for a person
kin means family

explanation.surface: A family holds up a relative stuck in a drain.
explanation.walkthrough: Sewer looks like a drain, but it is one who sews: a needle.
explanation.definitionFit: A bodkin is a blunt thick needle used for threading tape, so a tool that sews.

clue.text: One refusing to eat more quickly

definitions.meaning: first meaning: someone who abstains from food
second meaning: comparative of fast, speedier

explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a picky eater speeding up; it splits into a noun and a comparative adverb.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who goes without food is one who abstains, and the comparative of fast means quicker.

clue.text: Outstanding example of peer pressure going forward

indicators.note: going forward means the pressure letter moves to the front, ahead of the peer

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for pressure
an earl is a peer of the realm

explanation.surface: A management phrase about peer pressure going forward, perhaps a model case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going forward' is office jargon in the surface, but it tells you P goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A pearl is something prized and fine of its kind, as in 'a pearl of wisdom'.

clue.text: Nit-picker in strop about book

indicators.note: about means wrapping round the book

parts.note: a pet is a fit of sulking, a strop
Dan is short for Daniel, a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: A fussy person in a sulk over a book.
explanation.walkthrough: A strop is British slang for a bad mood, as is a pet.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedant fusses over trivial details and rules, a nit-picker.

clue.text: Set fire to some tedious list

parts.note: lit means set fire to
any means some, as in 'have you any?'

explanation.surface: Someone burns part of a boring list.
explanation.definitionFit: A litany is a long repetitive recital, such as a catalogue of complaints.

clue.text: Hatchet hidden in Norse god's chests

indicators.note: hidden in means the hatchet is placed inside the god's name

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder; with the possessive s, THORS
a hatchet is a small axe

explanation.surface: A hatchet lies concealed in Thor's storage chests.
explanation.walkthrough: Chests looks like boxes but is the anatomical plural.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorax is the part of the body between neck and abdomen, the chest.

clue.text: Dell peripheral initially installed for nothing

indicators.note: for means one letter stands in place of another

parts.note: a dongle is a small plug-in computer peripheral
O is nothing, the zero

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of installed

parts.note: first letter of installed

explanation.surface: A Dell computer peripheral installed for free.
explanation.walkthrough: Dell is the computer brand in the surface; it is the definition, a small wooded valley, and the dongle's O (nothing) gives way to I.
explanation.definitionFit: A dingle is a deep wooded hollow or valley, which is what a dell is.

clue.text: Lieutenant general dons headgear effortlessly

indicators.note: dons means the lieutenant wraps around the general, as clothing wraps its wearer

parts.note: Lt is the military abbreviation for lieutenant
Ike was the nickname of General Eisenhower
a hat is headgear

explanation.surface: A lieutenant general puts on a cap with ease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lieutenant general' reads as one rank, but splits into two: General Eisenhower's nickname was Ike.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something 'like that', with a snap of the fingers, means doing it easily and without effort.

clue.text: Modifies V-sign

parts.note: Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.walkthrough: V-sign looks like a rude gesture; split it into the letter V and a star sign.
explanation.definitionFit: To vary something is to change or alter it, which is what modifies means.

clue.text: Firm conservative in part of Greece

parts.note: Crete is a Greek island

explanation.surface: A conservative business firm operating in a region of Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: Firm wants to be a company; it is the adjective meaning solid.
explanation.definitionFit: Concrete things are solid and definite, as a firm plan or a firm surface is.

clue.text: Monster with very strange name

indicators.note: strange means the letters of very are put into an odd order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A monster bearing a very peculiar name.
explanation.definitionFit: A wyvern is a heraldic winged dragon with two legs, a mythical beast.
